page.overview:
What is Ironfists?

The Ironfists were one of the houses of the seven Seven Fathers of the Dwarves in Middle-earth. Presumably, as they do not appear in any of the tales, they lived far to the east where they were paired with the Stiffbeards. The Ironfists sent troops to fight in the War of the Dwarves and Orcs during the Third Age, as it is said that Durin's Folk called for aid from houses of other fathers of the Dwarves.
